decisions.reason: After several years and two years without visible market presence, this peripheral consumer product no longer justifies keeping even a low-cost option open versus redirecting effort to core industrial technologies.

Despite fitting the core business, its absence from the website through 2020-2021 suggests the stand-alone modular extension line has revealed limited traction, so resources are better folded back into established engineering offers and new development.

Its strategic relevance gives it higher option value, but two years of non-observation after launch indicate commercialization has not progressed strongly enough to warrant further dedicated market commitment.
